desc: Identify Geometry for LightNVM NVMe device
u: nvme-lnvm-id-ns - Identify Geometry for LightNVM NVMe device
Send an Identify Geometry command to the given LightNVM device, returns properties of the specified namespace in either human-readable or binary format.

<dl><dt data-o="">--namespace-id=<nsid>, -n <nsid></dt><dd>Retrieve the geometry from the selected namespace.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--force, -f</dt><dd>Try to read the data and assume it is a LightNVM device</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--raw-binary, -b</dt><dd>Output the raw output</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--human-readable, -H</dt><dd>Output the status in human readable format</dd></dl>

•Retrieve the geometry from nvme0
# nvme lnvm-id-ns /dev/nvme0 -n 1
